guide_trace.name: 横折
guide_trace.writing_hint: 尖锋斜切后右上行横，至折处提锋右上，斜按后转向下行，末端稍驻收笔。

guide_trace.name: 长横
guide_trace.writing_hint: 前半段渐提、中段较细，后半段渐按；末端转向收笔。

evidence.note: Image geometry only; width scaling and motion/magnetic transfer require paired trials.

guide_trace.name: 短横
guide_trace.writing_hint: 向右上行笔，宽度逐渐展开；末端转向收笔。

evidence.note: Image geometry only; width scaling and motion/magnetic transfer require paired trials.

guide_trace.name: 悬针竖
guide_trace.writing_hint: 尖起斜切右下轻按，左下移正后中锋直下，下段渐提收尖；白线止于墨迹尖端前约8像素，保持可见端点不外推。
